commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Tab trapping focus in command box
commitResults.messageBody:
When no autocomplete applies, Tab now moves keyboard focus from the
command box to the result output area (TextArea or contact ScrollPane),
and Tab from the output area returns focus to the command box. This
matches the documented behaviour: Tab to focus the output area and use
arrow keys to scroll; Ctrl+L / Command+L to return to command entry.

Changes:
- CommandBox: add onFocusOutput callback; on Tab, redirect focus to the
  output area when autocomplete has nothing to do (instead of letting
  the key propagate and get consumed by JavaFX traversal).
- ResultDisplay: add onFocusCommandBox callback; on Tab, redirect focus
  back to the command box. Add focus() helper that delegates to whichever
  output widget is currently visible. Expose focusTraversable on both
  widgets dynamically so only the active one participates in traversal.
- ResultDisplay.fxml: remove the hardcoded focusTraversable=false on
  contactScroll so the Java code can control it at runtime.
- MainWindow: wire the two callbacks together.
Support s/o and d/o in names and fix view unknown-prefix error

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Tab autocomplete appending duplicate prefix on reordered add command
commitResults.messageBody:
When all four required add prefixes (n/, c/, e/, p/) were already
present but in a different order from the canonical sequence, the
autocomplete logic could still append a duplicate prefix. The bug was
that the old code looked for the next prefix in the hard-coded list
order relative to the last-seen prefix, without checking whether that
prefix was already in the command.

Fix: before appending any prefix, verify all required prefixes are not
already present. When some are still missing, scan forward in the
canonical order and append the first one that is absent, skipping any
that were already supplied by the user.

Test: extend tabAutocomplete_completesCommandsAndRequiredPrefixes to
assert that Tab on a fully-specified but reordered add command leaves
the text unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix Tab autocomplete clearing command box undo history
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, CommandBox#setCommandText called TextField#setText(text),
which clears the JavaFX TextInputControl undo/redo history stack upon
invocation. As a result, pressing Command+Z (Ctrl+Z) after Tab autocomplete
could neither revert the autocomplete nor undo any typing prior to Tab.

Fix: replace TextField#setText(text) with
replaceText(0, commandTextField.getLength(), text), which records the
text modification as an undoable change in the undo manager, followed by
deselecting any highlighted text and positioning the caret at the end.
This allows the 1st Undo to revert the Tab completion and subsequent
Undos to revert previously typed text.

Test: add tabAutocomplete_preservesUndoHistory in MainWindowTest.
